method: Read existing 11October source inventory first, discover additional organizations, inspect primary recruitment boundaries and selected details through the web tool. Web-tool page content may be cached; this is manual discovery evidence, not app acquisition/runtime verification.
countingRules: Count one organization once even when its employer page and ATS use different domains.
Boundary inspection, current vacancy collection, talent pools, explicit no-current-position pages and unresolved widgets are distinct evidence states.
Observed role entries are selected leads/capacities and must not be summed as confirmed-open or distinct vacancies.
This file excludes the existing43targets and root's independent insurer/broker/fund-service discoveries.
